description_en: Queries the ID of a user in a resource directory by using the ExternalId parameter
description_zh: 调用GetUserId通过ExternalId获取目录下对应的用户ID
name: GetUserId

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource directory
parameters.name: directory_id

fields.help_en: The identifier of the user that is synchronized from an external IdP
fields.help_zh: 外部身份提供商的用户标识符
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: The method for external identity synchronization. Only System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) synchronization is supported
fields.help_zh: 外部身份同步渠道，当前仅支持SCIM同步
fields.name: issuer

parameters.help_en: The identifier information about the user that is synchronized from an external identity provider (IdP)
parameters.help_zh: 外部身份提供商的用户标识符信息
parameters.name: external_id
